name: @b/pkg-grammar-treesitter
description: tree-sitter grammar for BAML (single source of truth, mirrored read-only to BoundaryML/baml-treesitter for Neovim/Zed/Helix consumers).

scripts.test: tree-sitter generate && tree-sitter test && pnpm run parse-fixtures
scripts.parse-fixtures: sh -c 'fail=0; for f in ../pkg-grammar/tests/fixtures/*.baml; do n=$(tree-sitter parse "$f" | grep -cE "ERROR|MISSING"); if [ "$n" != 0 ]; then fail=1; echo "FAIL($n) $f"; fi; done; [ $fail = 0 ] && echo "all fixtures parse clean"; exit $fail' -
